notes: Type-specific checklists for the free-question games (docs/harness-gaps/open-text.md). The family default is left to the deduction family's writer.

slots.ask: A story Muse makes up, or one you name?
slots.why: A named classic riddle is used as the case; otherwise Muse writes an original one. Either way Muse writes the fact bank at build time.
slots.extrapolate_from: a quoted riddle or a 'like the one where...' in the request

slots.ask: What world should the mystery be set in?
slots.why: Sets the people, places and objects in the setup and every fact.
slots.extrapolate_from: named franchise, place, job or topic in the request

slots.ask: How many questions do players get?
slots.why: The budget is the difficulty and the score: fewer questions used scores more.

slots.ask: One case a day for a Group, or play anytime?
slots.why: A Group daily gives everyone the same case (same seed) so they can compare question counts.
slots.extrapolate_from: 'daily', 'for our group', 'group chat' in the request
